explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/104: 'Given n points in ℝ² the number of distinct unit circles containing at least three points is o(n²).' `unitCircleCount P` counts spheres (center, radius) in ℝ² with radius 1 containing at least three points of P; this set is finite (each such circle is determined by two of its points, at most two circles per pair), so `ncard` is the true count. `maxUnitCircleCount n` is the sSup over n-point configurations of a set bounded by about n(n-1)/3, hence a true maximum. The statement that this maximum is o(n²) is exactly the conjecture, and the open tag matches the page.
